exceptions.detail: Footprint/minimum-memory and four-/five-variable optimum-cost classifications, exhaustive counts, and vacuum-tube optima in exercises18–24 are not independently enumerated. Figure10 was visually read with selected structural checks, not a full functional/optimality certification of all sixteen networks.

Large sideways-addition examples, complete prefix/carry cost tables and exact small-n counting-bound table in48 were not regenerated. The recurrences and printed derivations were reviewed; external optimum results are accepted as cited.

The prime-implicant/minimum-cover classification in50, optimum parameter table52, S-box census58 and all-solution classification57 were not exhaustively reproduced. Tic-tac-toe formulas65 were read with their move priorities and corrections, but the4520-position optimality check, game counts and linked818-gate implementation67 were not independently replayed. Current19/11/12-step display circuits,13-step answer54,15-step answer59 and14-step answer55 were checked by hand.

Historical randomized decomposition trials, the full partial-function probability expansion72, external Stockmeyer–Meyer/Razborov/Lozhkin proofs, and the complete median census/optimality claims88 are not independently reproduced. Median formulas and the printed constructions were read, without a full truth-table check of every median network. The earlier precise exception for the lengthy Redkin proof77 remains. No open research or stronger optimum claim was attempted.
